name: the per-host preview setting is ignored
why: The preview is opt-in per host (sa_bs_detail_preview, default off). Without the check a hover with the setting off would fetch and show the card.

edits.find: return site && Lib.settings[site.setting] === true ? site : null;

grep: preview off, a hover shows nothing

name: the preview installs on MusicBrainz too
why: Only a foreign host has a _DP_SITES entry and only there is _initDetailPreview() called. Installed on MusicBrainz (here: as if it were brucespringsteen.it), the stylesheet and listeners would land on every MusicBrainz page.
grep: every preview setting on changes nothing

name: jungleland.it pages are decoded as UTF-8
why: jungleland.it serves windows-1252 with no charset. Decoded as UTF-8, 'Köln' comes out as 'K�ln' and the card's title is wrong.
grep: windows-1252 page is decoded

name: jungleland.it's unknown date 0000-00-00 is shown
why: The site writes an unknown date as 0000-00-00; the record leaves it out.
grep: jungleland.it: title, uploader

name: brucespringsteen.it's ditto marks are not carried down
why: The From column writes a double quote for 'same as above'. Without carrying the previous show down, 13 of CR1AD1's 14 tracks have the source '"'.
grep: ditto marks carried down

name: the tracklist table is recognised from the header row's whole text
why: The header row's textContent runs the cells together ('PosTitleFromNotesVer'), so a word-boundary test on it never matches and every record has no tracks.
grep: ditto marks carried down

name: the source's own whitespace is kept beside each
why:
The sites write 'line
\nline'. Keeping that newline as well as the
's makes every line a paragraph of its own, so bootleg 1331's unnumbered tracklist is read as 36 notes.
grep: springsteenlyrics.com: discs, a lineage note

name: an all-capitals title ending in a dot ends the unnumbered tracklist
why: Bootleg 1331 lists 'BORN IN THE U.S.A.'; without the all-capitals allowance the block is not title-like and the tracklist becomes notes.
grep: springsteenlyrics.com: discs, a lineage note

name: Esc does not hide the card
why: Esc closes the hover card (the request this feature answers).
grep: Esc hides the card

name: a Space typed into a field pins the card
why: While the user is typing in a field (the global filter), a Space is the field's; pinning would swallow it.
grep: a Space TYPED there stays typed

name: focus in a text field alone blocks the pin
why: The original defect: after a render the global filter has the focus without anyone typing, so 'focus in a field' alone meant Space never pinned.
grep: a Space TYPED there stays typed

name: the dialog leaves the focus in the global filter
why: Without moving the focus into the dialog, the render's focus in the filter keeps the arrow keys: the dialog's arrow handler steps aside for a text field.
grep: Esc hides the card

name: a hover that moved on still makes its request
why: The rate gate asks the waiting callers whether they still want the page before the request. Without it a sweep down the table fetches every row it passed.
grep: moved on by the time its slot comes up

name: a parsed page is not saved to IndexedDB
why: After a reload only the database has the record; without the write the page is fetched again.

edits.find: _dpIdbPut({ url, v: _DP_PARSER_VERSION, at, data }).catch(() => { /* memory still has it */ });

grep: survives a reload

name: the Live page view hides nothing around its root
why: The siblings of the kept root and of its ancestors are the site's navigation (springsteenlyrics.com: #header-top, the navbar, the breadcrumb, the footer).
grep: Live page view with the site's navigation hidden

name: the Live page view's hide switch is never applied
why: The hidden parts are hidden through html.mb-dp-isolate; without setting it on load, nothing is hidden.
grep: Live page view with the site's navigation hidden

name: the Live page frame runs the site's scripts
why: The frame is sandboxed without allow-scripts (no trackers, no pop-ups, no second run of the page's own code). The spec pins the sandbox attribute.
grep: Live page view with the site's navigation hidden

name: Brucebase's tab panels stay hidden in the Live page view
why: Without its scripts the wiki's tabview shows its first panel only; the view shows every panel under its label.
grep: the Live page with every tab

name: a tap on a detail link opens the page
why: A touch screen has no hover; the tap opens the dialog instead of the page.
grep: a tap on a detail link opens the dialog

name: the hover handler does not ignore a tap
why: Every hover tooltip ignores a tap's compatibility mouseover. Here the guard is covered by another: the tap's mousedown hides the card and clears its pending timer before the delay runs out, and the click then opens the dialog. Recorded so the overlap is known, not assumed.
grep: a tap on a detail link opens the dialog

name: the card is not in _OTHER_RICH_TIPS
why: The rule for every floating hover tooltip (toolbar-and-header-ui.md). No spec can see it: the card shows only while a detail link is hovered, and those links carry no script tooltip of their own. Recorded so the overlap is known.
grep: a hover loads the page once

name: lyrics.php?song= links are not detail links
why: The lyrics index's rows link to song pages; without the lyrics.php clause no card opens there (the report that started WIP.2).
grep: lyrics index: a song

name: a song page is read as an item card
why: A song page has no div.blog-post card; read by the item parser it yields nothing.
grep: springsteenlyrics.com song pages|lyrics index: a song

name: the site's SECTION NOT YET COMPLETED placeholders are kept
why: Placeholder lines carry nothing; a section that has only one would show as content.
grep: springsteenlyrics.com song pages

name: a song without lyrics does not say so
why: The 'Lyrics not available' alert becomes the record's note, which the card shows.
grep: springsteenlyrics.com song pages|lyrics index: a song

name: the Live page copy keeps the page's scripts
why: A page handed to the scriptless frame with its scripts in made Chrome log 'Blocked script execution … sandboxed' once per script (the report behind WIP.3).
grep: Live page view's copy|Live page view with the site's navigation hidden

name: the Live page copy keeps embedded videos as iframes
why: A YouTube player cannot start without scripts, and its fallback image 404s; the copy shows a link instead.
grep: Live page view's copy

name: the Live page copy has no base URL
why: A srcdoc document's relative URLs resolve against about:srcdoc, not the page, unless a <base href> names the page.
grep: Live page view's copy|Live page view with the site's navigation hidden

name: the Live page view fetches the page again after a hover
why: The hover (or the Extracted view) fetched the page already; the Live page view reuses it from _dpRawMem.
grep: Live page view with the site's navigation hidden

name: ⟳ reuses the remembered page
why: ⟳ reads the page again; in the Live page view that must bypass _dpRawMem.
grep: Live page view with the site's navigation hidden

name: the frame's about:blank document is treated as the page
why: A new frame's initial about:blank fires a load too. The load listener is attached only after srcdoc is set, so it never sees that document; the guard is the second line. Recorded so the overlap is known.
grep: Live page view with the site's navigation hidden

name: the Live page copy keeps inline handlers and javascript: URLs
why: The sandbox refuses every on… attribute as the page is parsed and Chrome logs each (eight on a Brucebase song page, the WIP.4 report); javascript: links did nothing there anyway.
grep: Live page view's copy|the Live page with every tab
